$note: Showcase producer flow at 480x270 instead of the upstream 1080p. A 3x3 multiviewer renders nine tiles at ~426x238, so producing at 1080p (v210 ~5.3 MB/grain) only to scale down wastes producer CPU and fabric bandwidth and is what kept a single writer pod from sustaining all 9 flows. At 480x270 the grain is ~0.33 MB (~16x smaller). Width is a multiple of 48 (v210 packs 6 px / 16 B); Cb/Cr are half width (4:2:2). The compositor must read at the same size (MXL_FRAME_WIDTH/HEIGHT=480/270).
